captions.detailed: An under-slung robotic arm assembly featuring a dark grey, upright cantilever support stand with a top-mounted overhang. Suspended from this top support is a multi-segment robotic arm consisting of two light grey, blocky link structures connected in series, followed by a dark grey end-effector tool. The entire assembly utilizes sequential shoulder, elbow, and wrist revolute joints, allowing the suspended chain to rotate and articulate below the main mounting structure.
captions.instruction: Generate a Python script using CadQuery to model an under-slung robotic cantilever arm. The model should include a dark grey vertical base support with a top overhanging mount, two light grey intermediate linkage segments suspended below, and a dark grey end-effector, connected sequentially with revolute shoulder, elbow, and wrist joints.
captions.factory: The code constructs an ArticulatedObject by defining custom materials for dark grey and light grey components. It builds the static base link using combined box primitives to form the upright and overhanging support. It then defines three additional moving links (shoulder/upper arm, lower arm, and wrist/end-effector) using offset box primitives, connecting them sequentially using revolute joints with specified rotation axes and spatial origins.
